description: The account's images (web app included), newest first; page with `cursor` = the previous `next_cursor` while `has_more`. WHEN: the user asks what they made, or you need an earlier image's `url`. To let them CHOOSE one: `show_images`.

cursor.description: The previous response's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

name: list_images
title: List the account's AI images
